review.headline: Session matched the planned distance and structure; reps averaged 4:00/km against a 3:55/km target with HR peaking at 174.
observations: Warm-up 2.0 km at 5:45/km (HR 135) and cool-down 2.0 km at 5:45/km (HR 142) were both easy and within the 5:11-6:13 band.
The 1.6 km rep block averaged 4:00/km (HR 171), about 5 s/km off the 3:55/km target, so the reps were close to plan.
The three 0.4 km jogs were covered in 1.2 km at 6:20/km (HR 145), a sensible recovery pace.
Total distance was 6.8 km, exactly as planned.
flags: The reps were not lapped separately, so rep-by-rep evenness can't be checked; km splits show 4:00, 4:56 and 6:13, which blends reps and jogs.
No RPE or athlete note was logged, so effort is judged from HR and pace only.
Training has stopped since this session: no runs logged from 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-25, and week 3 reached only 15.8 of 43.4 planned km.
CTL dropped 5.9 over the last 7 days to 40.2, and TSB is -1.5 after this session.
